weekly_home_plan_spec.architecture: Unified Home Practice Hub with segmented tab switcher: [Weekly Home Practice Plans] and [Short Video Guides]. Integrates unread badge counters across top navbar, mobile bottom nav, and portal tabs.

fields: checklist_items (array of 1-6 item objects containing text, category [sleep|food|activity|routine|communication], and status)

features: Current Active Week Plan with completion progress bar (e.g., 4/5 completed)
Interactive checkboxes for 1-6 items with smooth check animation and strike-through transition
Category Pill Badges with icons (Moon for Sleep, Apple for Food, Activity for Exercise, Calendar for Routine, Message for Communication)
'Why this helps' callout box with gentle warm sage background and lightbulb icon
Weekly parent comment box allowing one brief summary reflection sent directly to the therapist
Past Plans History Drawer/Accordion grouped by week date range

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, checkboxes, tabs, status badges, textareas) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

3d_libraries.use_case: Not required for core home practice & task checklists. Rely on micro-animations, clear check progress indicators, and crisp Shadcn components.

instructions_to_main_agent: Extend the existing practice hub in Parent.jsx and Staff.jsx to host both [Weekly Home Practice Plans] and [Short Video Guides] under a cohesive tabbed layout.
Implement Therapist Weekly Plan Composer with 1-6 checklist items, guidance categories (sleep, food, activity, routine, communication), goal note, and 'why this helps' note.
Provide Therapist controls to Publish, Edit, and Withdraw plans, plus view parent completion progress and weekly comments.
Implement Parent Weekly Practice Plan view with interactive item completion checkboxes, completion progress indicator, 'Why this helps' summary card, and weekly parent comment input.
Organize weekly plans by date and maintain a collapsible history of past published plans.
Add unread notification indicators across the app header, sidebar, and plan cards when new weekly plans are assigned.
Strictly maintain existing Fraunces & Manrope typography and warm care-focused color palette, ensuring data-testid attributes are present on all elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered slop layout; use warm, structured organic cards with clear visual hierarchy.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-5 or p-6) to prevent text collision.
Always set explicit hover and focus text colors to guarantee APCA contrast compliance.
Keep standard JavaScript React (.js/.jsx) file extensions consistent with existing codebase structure.
